skill.summary: 提供天创财务相关文档的严格逐字检索，返回精准原文或“无”，不做解释和修改，仅限中文内容。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Tianchuang Finance Knowledge Base Skill.
- Enables strict document retrieval from Tianchuang Financial’s 8 official PDF policy documents.
- Returns only verbatim matching Chinese text for queries; otherwise replies with "无".
- No summaries, reasoning, or alterations to the retrieved content.
- Automatically triggers on finance-related questions with defined keywords.
- Maintains complete fidelity to source materials, prioritizing strong matches.
